summary: Grows the dynamic element array when the used count (this[0x14]) plus one exceeds capacity (this[0xC]). New capacity is computed by adding growth stride this[0x1C] until it covers count + 1; a new 4 * i-byte buffer (2 WORDs per element) is allocated and zero-initialized, the first this[0x14] elements are copied from the old array this[0x8], the old buffer is freed, and this[0x8]/this[0xC] are updated. Returns 1 on success and on the no-growth path; 0 only when the allocation fails.

Allocate 4 * i bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; return 0 if the allocation is null.
Zero-initialize all i elements of the new array, each element being 2 WORDs.
Copy the first this[0x14] used elements (4 bytes each, 2 WORDs) from the old array this[0x8] into the new array.
Free the old array buffer (this[0x8]) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Store the new array pointer in this[0x8] and the new capacity in this[0xC].
Return 1 on success (both the no-growth and grown paths); 0 only when the allocation failed.
